result.topic_en: Lambert-series expansions of a binary theta series T and its square (related to the form $\mu^2+\mu\nu+2\nu^2$ and the number 7), followed by Lambert-series formulas for quotients of theta-type functions $\phi$, $\psi$, $f$ at arguments $x$, $x^3$, $x^5$, $x^9$.
result.transcription:
Add. Ms. a.94 18(98) (98) (7)

(3.41) $T = \sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\mu^2+\mu\nu+2\nu^2} = 1 + 2\left(\frac{x}{1-x}+\frac{x^2}{1-x^2}\right.$
$\left. - \frac{x^3}{1-x^3}+\frac{x^4}{1-x^4}-\frac{x^5}{1-x^5}-\frac{x^6}{1-x^6}+\frac{x^8}{1-x^8}+\cdots\right)$
(3.42) $T^2 = 1 + 4\left(\frac{x}{1-x}+\frac{2x^2}{1-x^2}+\frac{3x^3}{1-x^3}+\frac{4x^4}{1-x^4}+\frac{5x^5}{1-x^5}\right.$
$\left.+\frac{6x^6}{1-x^6}+\frac{8x^8}{1-x^8}+\cdots\right)$,
where 1, 2, 3, .... are the natural numbers without the multiples of 7.
The following formulae seem to be of some interest in itself though they haven't got a simple arithmetical interpretation as the preceding ones.
(3.51) $\frac{\phi^3(x)}{\phi(x^3)} = 1 + 6\left(\frac{x}{1-x}+\frac{x^2}{1+x^2}-\frac{x^4}{1+x^4}-\frac{x^5}{1-x^5}+\cdots\right)$
(3.52) $\frac{\phi^3(x^3)}{\phi(x)} = 1 - 2\left(\frac{x}{1+x}-\frac{x^2}{1-x^2}+\frac{x^4}{1-x^4}-\frac{x^5}{1+x^5}+\cdots\right)$
(3.61) $\frac{\psi^3(x)}{\psi(x^3)} = 1 + 3\left(\frac{x}{1-x}-\frac{x^5}{1-x^5}+\frac{x^7}{1-x^7}-\cdots\right)$
(3.62) $\frac{x\psi^3(x^3)}{\psi(x)} = \frac{x}{1-x^2}-\frac{x^2}{1-x^4}+\frac{x^4}{1-x^8}-\frac{x^5}{1-x^{10}}+\cdots$
(3.71) $\frac{f^3(x)}{f(x^3)} = 1 - 3\left(\frac{x}{1-x}-\frac{x^2}{1-x^2}+\frac{x^4}{1-x^4}-\frac{x^5}{1-x^5}+\cdots\right)$
$+ 9\left(\frac{x^3}{1-x^3}-\frac{x^6}{1-x^6}+\frac{x^{12}}{1-x^{12}}-\frac{x^{15}}{1-x^{15}}+\cdots\right)$
(3.72) $\frac{xf^3(x^9)}{f(x^3)} = \frac{x}{1-x}-\frac{x^2}{1-x^2}+\frac{x^4}{1-x^4}-\frac{x^5}{1-x^5}+\cdots$
$-\left(\frac{x^3}{1-x^3}-\frac{x^6}{1-x^6}+\frac{x^{12}}{1-x^{12}}-\frac{x^{15}}{1-x^{15}}+\cdots\right)$
(3.81) $\frac{f^5(x)}{f(x^5)} = 1 - 5\left(\frac{x}{1-x}-\frac{2x^2}{1-x^2}-\frac{3x^3}{1-x^3}+\frac{4x^4}{1-x^4}\right.$
$\left.+\frac{6x^6}{1-x^6}-\frac{7x^7}{1-x^7}-\cdots\right)$
(3.82) $\frac{xf^5(x^5)}{f(x)} = \frac{x}{(1-x)^2}-\frac{x^2}{(1-x^2)^2}-\frac{x^3}{(1-x^3)^2}+\frac{x^4}{(1-x^4)^2}$
$+\frac{x^6}{(1-x^6)^2}-\frac{x^7}{(1-x^7)^2}-\cdots\cdots$

methods.what: Lambert series for the theta series of the binary quadratic form $\mu^2+\mu\nu+2\nu^2$ (discriminant -7)
Lambert series for the square of that theta series, summed over n not divisible by 7
Lambert series for $f^5(x)/f(x^5)$ with Legendre-symbol mod 5 coefficients
Series for $xf^5(x^5)/f(x)$ in terms of $x^n/(1-x^n)^2$ with characters mod 5
